verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms Fin publishes an llms.txt file at https://fin.ai/llms.txt (HTTP 200) explicitly framed to help LLMs understand its content structure, and Fin also offers an MCP server and a CLI agents can be pointed at for setup. Missing for 10: markdown-doc mirrors (docs-md probe 404) and a discoverable OpenAPI spec (all candidates 404), which would round out agent-friendly documentation.
